goal: each repro area record holds the session's num_turns beside the run's max_turns and a turns_over_cap flag when num_turns passed it, carried by repro record and compare; agent_bench.result_of treats a result whose subtype starts with error_ as an error whatever is_error says, so bench_repro.failure_of names it turns or budget

notes: Premise (lessons analysis 1.6): 14 sessions of the first run recorded 201 to 268 turns with subtype success under --max-turns 200, while the CLI reference says the run exits with an error at the limit (live docs, code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference, 2026-10-15). The goal research story records what the CLI counts as a turn; this story records the fact per area and does not guess the cause. Merges BG-bzem6xtn (error_max_turns with is_error false read as finished), whose repro is the second check. Checks that pass before the work: the test selection pass before the work and are kept as guards (the change must keep them green); checks 0 and 1 fails before the work and reads the goal. Each guard check named above as passing on the base passes before the work: it pins behaviour that must stay green (a test selection the work extends, the eval, the lint); the item's failing checks read its goal.
